CHART.TITLE: Conversations by day

CHART.AI_TOTAL: AI agent replied, day by day
CHART.TEAM_TOTAL: Your team replied, day by day

REPORTS.TITLE: Detailed reports
REPORTS.SUBTITLE: Every number in full, with filters and downloads.

ITEMS.LIVE: Open conversations, who is online and the busiest hours of the week.
ITEMS.CONVERSATIONS: Conversations, messages, reply and solve times over any period.
ITEMS.AGENTS: Each person: conversations, time to first reply and solved.
ITEMS.TEAMS: The same numbers for each team.
ITEMS.INBOXES: The same numbers for each channel: chat, email, WhatsApp.
ITEMS.LABELS: Conversations by label, to see what customers ask about.
ITEMS.AI_AGENT: Conversations your AI agent solved or handed to your team, over time.
ITEMS.RATING: Every customer rating with its comment, by person and channel.
ITEMS.TARGETS: Conversations that missed a reply-time target, and why.

PEOPLE.TITLE: Your team
PEOPLE.EMPTY: Nobody on your team replied in this period.

AI.STAYED_TOTAL: Stayed with the AI agent, day by day
AI.HANDED_TOTAL: Handed to your team, day by day
AI.NOTE: Each bar counts the conversations your AI agent replied in that day; amber is the part it handed to your team.
AI.EMPTY: Your AI agent had no conversations in this period.

TEAM.EMPTY: Your team replied in no conversation in this period.
TEAM.NO_TEAMS: No team had conversations in this period.

RATING.EMPTY: No ratings in this period yet.
RATING.NO_COMMENTS: No comments with the ratings in this period.

ANALYTICS.UNSUPPORTED_PERIOD: This report range is unsupported. Showing the last 7 days; choose a supported range above.

DEFINITIONS.CONVERSATIONS: Unique conversations created in this period, across the workspace. Daily chart activity counts replies and uses a different denominator.
DEFINITIONS.AI_CONVERSATIONS: Unique conversations in which an AI agent authored a message during this period. This is activity, not billable AI usage.
DEFINITIONS.RESOLVED: AI resolve events divided by conversations with an AI message in the period. Bot resolves after a handoff are excluded. This is a percentage, not a conversation count.
DEFINITIONS.HANDED: Unique conversations with an AI handoff event in the period among conversations with AI messages in the reporting windows. A higher count can mean appropriate escalation.
DEFINITIONS.PRODUCT_ANSWERS: Unique conversations with an assistant session that used a product source during this period.
DEFINITIONS.FIRST_REPLY: Average time to first response from the conversation report, across the workspace.
DEFINITIONS.RESOLUTION_TIME: Average time to resolution from the conversation report, across the workspace.
DEFINITIONS.TEAM_SOLVED: Resolution count from the workspace conversation report; includes all resolution paths, not only human agents.
DEFINITIONS.RATING: Average customer rating from 1 to 5 across the workspace. A dash means no ratings are available.
DEFINITIONS.RATINGS_COUNT: Number of customer ratings received in this period across the workspace.
DEFINITIONS.HAPPY_SHARE: Ratings of 4 or 5 divided by all ratings received in this period.
DEFINITIONS.REPLY_SHARE: Ratings received divided by rating requests sent, capped at 100%. This compares period totals, not a matched customer cohort.
